projectDescription: MapX is an AI-powered spatial analysis platform that lets anyone turn CSV and GeoJSON data into interactive maps, heatmaps, and professional reports using plain English — no GIS training required.
keyFeatures: Plain-English AI chat interface for spatial queries
Auto-detection of location columns in CSV, GeoJSON, and Excel files
GPU-accelerated WebGL rendering for 100K+ data points at 60fps
Spatial operations: buffer, overlay, spatial join, heatmap, site scoring
One-click professional report generation with maps, charts, and AI insights
Custom map styling: colors, dark mode basemaps, branded exports
Public and private map sharing with editable access controls
Team collaboration (up to 5 seats on Pro, unlimited on Enterprise)
White-label reports and scheduled auto-reporting on Enterprise
SSO and admin controls for Enterprise customers
publicApiSurface: AI chat prompt — describe spatial analysis in plain English
File upload — CSV, GeoJSON, Excel with auto column detection
Map layer controls — style, color, basemap selection
Report export — one-click HTML report generation
Share link — public or private map sharing
PNG export — watermark-free on paid plans
